info.title: Movie Ticket Booking API
info.description:
Cities, theaters, screens, movies, shows and seat-level booking.

**Auth:** call `POST /api/auth/login`, copy `accessToken`, click **Authorize**
and paste it. Admin endpoints need an ADMIN token; browsing is public.

Every error uses the `ApiError` shape with a stable `error` code.

rules.description: Time bands; cancelling at least minHoursBeforeShow hours before the show refunds refundPercent. Below every band the refund is 0%.

active.description: Make this the active policy (deactivates the current one)

adjustmentPercent.description: Percent added to base prices; negative for a reduction

windowStart.description: PRIME_TIME only: window start (inclusive), show local time

code.description: 3-30 letters, digits, '_' or '-'; stored upper case

discountValue.description: Percent (1-100) for PERCENT, amount for FLAT

maxDiscountAmount.description: PERCENT only: cap on the discount amount

minOrderAmount.description: Minimum subtotal for the code to apply

usageLimit.description: Total confirmed uses allowed; empty = unlimited

perUserLimit.description: Confirmed uses per customer; empty = unlimited

paymentToken.description: Mock gateway token: tok_success (default), tok_declined, tok_insufficient_funds, tok_error

startTime.description: Start time with offset; must be in the future

prices.description: Base price per seat type; required for every seat type on the screen
